concepts.anchor: ## Sources, alongside other Braintree chargeback sources
concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-risk-and-security-chargebacks-retrievals-disputing-chargebacks]] - 2026-09-16 general Braintree guide for account-dependent chargeback acceptance and dispute choices, card-brand-defined evidence conditions, refund-overlap risk, beta evidence recommendations and narrowly qualified pre-arbitration guidance; not bank-specific procedure, current universal policy or an outcome guarantee
warnings: Keep notification, acceptance, dispute and evidence procedures account-dependent and routed to the applicable bank-specific article.

Scope the August 27, 2025 pre-arbitration auto-accept statement to U.S. flat-rate merchants and this captured snapshot; do not apply it to NAB, interchange pricing, non-U.S. merchants or universal current policy.
Do not turn evidence recommendations or quantity into a guarantee of card-brand acceptance or a favorable dispute outcome.
